Title: Public preview: Azure SQL updates for early February 2022

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—Public preview updates for early February 2022

In early February 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • User-Assigned managed identity support for TDE BYOK in Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
